text:
nina: SAST job is failing on a bunch of PRs this morning with KMS Decrypt denied. scanner can't open private submodule blobs to analyze, so results are missing. filing here for triage.
tom: which scanner and what error? can you paste logs?
nina: using sast-runner v3 (scanner@ci) invoked from pr-checks. sample error: 
```
2026-04-12T09:12:03Z ERROR scanner: failed to decrypt blob key=gitmodule-blob-id err=AccessDeniedException: not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/face-b00c
```
yara: I saw a few deploy PRs for the keystore team last night. they rolled a tighter key policy with a condition limiting via aws:PrincipalTag/team=security-tooling. scanner role doesn't have that tag.
sec-bot: automated-note: created alert ALERT-2026-1874 for failing-sast-prs; affected-prs=18; severity=high; suggested-action=review key policy and principal tags.
infra-keystore: confirmed, we applied a policy change to reduce blast radius after last month's audit. the key policy now requires the caller principal to have tag team=security-tooling OR to assume a grant role. we meant to update service accounts but missed the scanner SA.
alex: ok immediate options: 1) roll back policy (fast but weakens security), 2) tag scanner service account with team=security-tooling (requires org-level tagging flow + short downtime), 3) provision an ephemeral grant role `sast-decrypt-ephemeral` and require assume-role for CI (low blast, minimal policy change).
carol: compliance note: any ephemeral grant must be logged and the audit trail preserved; evidence used for vulnerability decisions must be immutable. if we decrypt artifacts to resume scans, snapshot the decrypted blobs into an immutable evidence bucket.
nina: agree on ephemeral grant for triage. we need scans to run to unblock PRs. can someone request the grant and get it in the next 30m?
infra-keystore: we can create an IAM role-based grant and add a key-grant with constraints (4h expiration, requestor principal logged). will require a ticket and approver. ticket id KGRANT-9021 will appear in the keystore audit.
yara: also let's add a CI change to attempt an assume-role flow before decrypt and fail early with a clearer error. that will make triage faster in the future.
sec-bot: automated-note: created ticket SEC-2026-300: "sast-key-policy-blocks-scanner" assigned to yara; SLA=24h.
carol: forensics/process: (1) create immutable snapshot of current encrypted blobs (2) once transient grant exists, decrypt copies into evidence bucket with write-once policy and attach checksums + CloudTrail event ids to SEC ticket (3) run scans and attach results; do not mutate original S3 objects.
nina: I'll coordinate the snapshot and attach manifest. tom, can you coordinate with infra-keystore to expedite the grant?
tom: on it. pinging @infra-keystore for KGRANT-9021 approval now.
infra-keystore: granted: created grant ARN arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:grant/GR-3344 for principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/sast-decrypt-ephemeral valid 4h. audit request id KGRANT-9021 logged.
sec-bot: automated-note: ephemeral grant created KGRANT-9021; link=internal-keystore/GR-3344; expiry=2026-04-12T13:30:00Z.
yara: deployed small CI patch that tries to assume-role `sast-decrypt-ephemeral` before decrypt step; if assume fails we fail fast with a diagnostic. PR: github.com/redwood/ci/+/2345
alex: long-term fixes: (A) update service account onboarding to include required principal tags for keystore-scoped keys, (B) add a preflight unit test in PR checks that runs a dry-run decrypt (or tags verification) to catch policy mismatches early, (C) catalog keys that are used by CI and include them in a runbook.
carol: also recommend an automated nightly check that attempts to decrypt a small sentinel artifact for each key used by CI pipelines and alerts on failures. that's lower-cost monitoring to prevent silent breakage.
nina: all good. immediate owners: tom->coordinate grant and attach audit ref; yara->CI patch + follow-up PR; carol->evidence snapshot + runbook entry; alex->preflight/dry-run job proposal.
sec-bot: automated-note: created followup tasks: SEC-2026-301 (CI dry-run job), SEC-2026-302 (immutable-evidence-snapshot), assigned accordingly.
tom: merge gating note: for the next 48h add a temporary check to block merges touching keystore or scanner infra until tagging/onboarding update merged. I'll open a brief policy PR in the repo.
nina: thanks team. please post any audit ids or the snapshot manifest into SEC-2026-300 and mark the thread when triage completes. keeping this open until scans are green.
